text:
Will P.: Nebula sent their final asset zip and asked for marketplace tiles + a 1-pager + a short customer story. uploaded to drive: https://drive.reed/redwood/nebula/co-brand-v2.zip
Raj (Partner): thanks! Nebula's brand lead requests their full-color lockup only, no recolor. they also want their tagline included under the logo.
Maria C.: that could conflict with our thumbnail constraints. marketplaces often limit space. which marketplaces are we targeting?
Sara (PM): target: AWS marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and our listing on Partner Portal. AWS tile prefers 900x450 (horizontal) and 300x300 square for card views, Azure wants 1:1 300x300 and large 1200x960 for the hero. Portal uses 600x400. I'll add exact specs to checklist.
Devon (Design): saw Nebula logos. full-color works on light backgrounds, but on dark hero images we need the white lockup. is there a usage permission for alt versions?
Raj (Partner): they only signed off on full-color + reversed white for dark backgrounds. explicitly disallow altering color.
Devon (Design): OK. will prepare both variants: `nebula_lockup_rgb.svg` and `nebula_lockup_revwhite.svg`. question: partner insists tagline remains on the lockup — that will reduce our headline space on the 1-pager. suggestion: keep tagline on the dedicated co-badge, but remove tagline from condensed marketplace thumbnails.
Maria C.: legal/brand check: partner's guide has a strict spacing of 20px clearzone. our guide uses 16px. can we compromise and add a 2px divider when placed tight?
sam-legal: legal note: require partner brand usage agreement signed for alternate logo usage. also they request a mandatory credit line: "Nebula trademark used with permission" — that must appear in footer copy. I can draft language. regarding clearspace, document any deviation and get written approval from Nebula.
Devon (Design): quick mock for tile layouts uploaded: `s3://rdw-assets/mockups/1987654321-tiles/` — i made horizontal and square crops with the tagline trimmed for the square.
Sara (PM): timeline check: partner requested assets by Wed EOD. realistic internal timeline: design final by Tue, legal sign-off Wed morning, publishing Wed afternoon. if partner can accept Thu that's safer.
Will P.: pinging partner for confirmation of timeline and to request signed brand usage PDF. Raj can you get the approval today?
Raj (Partner): yes, i'll ask and push legal to send the signed form today.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketplace packaging requires alt text and 2 sample screenshots for AWS. See: https://infra.aws/marketplace/asset-requirements
Devon (Design): one more ask: Nebula's primary maroon color conflicts with our brand accent on the hero. they asked to keep maroon dominant. to preserve contrast i propose using our neutral gray as background and placing Nebula logotype on a white slab — keeps their color intact while meeting accessibility. mock attached in folder.
Maria C.: accessibility check: fonts must meet AA contrast on thumbnails. Devon please run `axe` on final PNGs and attach results.
Devon (Design): will run `axe` and include the report. also exporting sRGB JPEGs at 72dpi as AWS requested. will add alt text drafts.
sam-legal: draft footer language: "Nebula Systems logo used with permission. Trademarks are the property of their respective owners." good?
Maria C.: tidy. also we need to avoid language implying certification. partner mentioned "validated on Redwood infra" in their brief — legal: change to "validated in joint testing" unless they can provide compliance artifacts.
Raj (Partner): i'll confirm wording with Nebula marketing. they prefer "validated in joint testing" so should be fine.
Will P.: final deliverables list: 900x450 JPEG hero (RGB), 300x300 PNG square (white and reversed), 600x400 portal image, one-sheet PDF (print-ready + web), 1-pager customer story (editable). Devon export zip and upload to drive under `deliverables/final/1987654321/`.
Devon (Design): exporting now. naming convention: `rdw-nebula_hero_900x450_v1.jpg`, `rdw-nebula_square_300x300_v1.png`, `rdw-nebula_onepager_v1.pdf`. will include `usage_agreement_required.txt` in the zip as a placeholder.
Sara (PM): i'll prefill marketplace submission forms and add notes about tagline removal on square tiles. will attach the checklist: https://confluence/repo/marketplace/checklists/nebula-co-brand
sam-legal: i'll review final assets Wed 9am PT. if the usage agreement isn't in place, legal cannot approve the reversed white version.
brand-bot: FYI: Redwood brand v2 requires vector lockups for print. attach `.svg` for the one-pager print PDF.
Will P.: thanks team. next: Raj please confirm signed usage agreement and preferred final wording; Devon upload exports; Sara prepare marketplace packages. we'll reconvene here once uploads are live. :thumbsup:
